desc: Test whether ANS2 accepts Flush when the NVMMU TCB carries no DMA direction (dma_flags=0 for prp1==0), as mainline/Asahi apple.c and m1n1 c16d3c7 do. 5006 and 211 run 1 used dma_flags FROM_DEVICE (kernel) or 3 (m1n1) and got status 2. Candidate patch patches/t6040-nvme-apple-flush-nodma.patch (opt-in NVME_FLUSH_NODMA=1, builds on the reconstructed base; flushtest Image c8db676a, untested on hardware). First step is an m1n1-side Flush probe with dma_flags=0 (no writes), then the kernel build behind the 5008 gates. If it works, write-through can be dropped and Gravity's delayed-flush throttle (flush_interval) becomes relevant. Not for the daily/5019 object.
author: claude
